articles.title: Professional Presentations 职业演讲
articles.summary: Structuring talks, presenting data and engaging an audience.

sentences.orig: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for taking the time to attend today's presentation on our quarterly performance.
sentences.trans: 大家早上好。感谢各位抽出时间参加今天的季度业绩演示。

sentences.orig: Let me begin by outlining the key objectives of our strategy for the coming fiscal year.
sentences.trans: 首先，让我概述我们下一财年战略的主要目标。

sentences.orig: As you can see from this chart, our market share has grown steadily over the past three quarters.
sentences.trans: 从这个图表可以看出，过去三个季度我们的市场份额稳步增长。

sentences.orig: I'd like to draw your attention to a critical finding that emerged from our latest consumer survey.
sentences.trans: 我想提请各位注意我们最新消费者调查中得出的一个关键发现。

sentences.orig: To sum up, our strong financial position provides a solid foundation for aggressive expansion next year.
sentences.trans: 总而言之，我们强劲的财务状况为明年的积极扩张提供了坚实基础。

sentences.orig: If you have any questions, I'll be happy to address them at the end of the presentation.
sentences.trans: 如果各位有任何问题，我很乐意在演示结束时解答。

sentences.orig: Looking ahead, we anticipate significant growth opportunities in emerging markets.
sentences.trans: 展望未来，我们预计新兴市场存在重大增长机遇。

sentences.orig: I want to emphasise that this initiative would not have been possible without the dedication of our entire team.
sentences.trans: 我想强调，没有整个团队的奉献，这一计划是不可能实现的。

questions.question: What has grown steadily over three quarters?
What provides a solid foundation for expansion?
